{{flag|Australia}} and territories: May apply online (Online Visitor e600 visa).
{{flag|Belize}}: Permanent residents and holders of multiple entry visa of the United States may obtain a visa on arrival for a fee of US$50. Passengers with a valid visa issued by a Schengen Member State are visa exempt for a maximum stay of 90 days.
{{flag|Bosnia and Herzegovina}}: Holders of a multiple-entry Schengen Area Visa, can enter and stay in Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 15 days upon every entry per period of 180 days, if visa previously used in one of the Schengen Area.
{{flag|Costa Rica|state}}: Resident permit holders of the European Union may enter for 30 days; as well as multiple-entry visa holders of Canada and the U.S. Green Cards or U.S. visas must be valid for more than six months on arrival except for holders of B or D visas. Not applicable to holders of C1 visas.
{{flag|Dominican Republic}}: Visa exemption applies to residents and valid visa holders of Canada, the United States and the European Union.

{{flag|Gabon}}: Electronic visa holders must arrive via Libreville International Airport.

{{flag|South Korea}}: Non-visa-exempt nationals who are in transit through South Korea are visa-exempt for 30 days, provided holding a physical visa or a residence permit issued by the following countries and are arriving at South Korea from one of these countries and continuing to a third country, or arriving from a third country and continuing to one of these countries: Australia, New Zealand, Canada, United States.

{{flag|Macedonia}}:
Holders of a valid Type "C" multiple entry visa or Permanent Residency for the Schengen Area may enter Macedonia for up to 15 days visa free. A temporary residence permit (with expiration date) is not accepted.
Holders of a valid UK, Canada or USA visa may enter Macedonia for up to 15 days visa free.
Holders of UN travel documents do not require a visa.
{{flag|Mexico}}:
Malagasy passport holders are visa exempt if they hold a valid visa for Canada, United States, United Kingdom, Japan or Schengen
Malagasy passport holders are visa exempt if they hold residence from Canada, United States, United Kingdom, Japan, Schengen, Colombia or Peru
